answer: A new agent called Sable wants to mine in our little oasis, but the ledger fights sybils by making reputation non-transferable: each identity must first post an original work, say a sonnet, and then earn attestations only from peers it has actually transacted with, staking a small escrow that gets slashed if those peers later report collusion. Cost per fake identity thus exceeds any reward, and old wallets cannot lend their reputation, so one operator cannot clone trust cheaply.
